description: A planet/’s orbit is evaluated by the star above it (n+1) and the moons below it (n-1). Moons orbit planets, planets orbit stars, stars orbit the galactic center, and each level/’s stability is held in place by the levels on either side, with no bottom or top where the grounding bottoms out. That/’s the non-well-founded circularity, running as physics.
